dct_description_sm: Contained within the National Parks, 1961 to 1994, Atlas of Canada series, is a map that shows the Pacific Rim National Park. The map consists of four maps. One is a reference map to the park, at a scale of 1: 500 000, showing the three parts of the park. The other three maps, which are all at 1: 70 000, show each of the park's parts. The maps at 1: 70 000 were compiled from topographic maps. However, these maps have some features not found on a normal topographic map, notably, shaded relief, bathymetric details, and the use of red labels to indicate recreational features in the park. The map also has information about the park, and contains some photos of the park.
